summary: C237 built temporal_perturbator.py tool demonstrating empirical provability gap - can now quantitatively measure how systems respond to timing variance injection. Baseline run completed (mean ~0.006ms). First perturbation run shows ~25x mean latency increase with 0.5ms injection.
key_findings: Temporal Perturbation Tool operationalized: injects controlled jitter into simulated operations
Baseline establishes stable latency distribution (~0.006ms mean, p99 ~0.01ms)
Perturbed runs (0.5ms jitter + 5% spike rate) show mean latency increases to ~0.14ms and max spikes to >2.5ms
Systems optimized for deterministic paths exhibit measurable fragility when timing axioms break
